r_system_type_mismatch.msg: {species} does not suit the selected system type ({system}).
r_system_type_mismatch.remedy: Change the system type or replace the species with a compatible one.

r_system_airflow_high.msg: {species} needs constant fresh air and will die in a sealed jar.
r_system_airflow_high.remedy: Use a ventilated or open system, or replace the species.

r_system_airflow_medium.msg: {species} tolerates a closed system only with regular airing.
r_system_airflow_medium.remedy: Air 1–2 hours weekly and keep springtails.

r_condensation_closed.msg: {species} cannot tolerate leaf condensation — leaves will melt in a sealed jar.
r_condensation_closed.remedy: Replace with a condensation-resistant species or use a semi-open system.

r_condensation_semi.remedy: Open or well-ventilated system only, or replace the species.

r_habitat_aquatic.msg: {species} is an aquatic or bog species and needs open water.
r_habitat_aquatic.remedy: Enable open water (paludarium) or remove the species.

r_volume_plant_closed.msg: {species} needs at least {min_volume} L in a closed system; you have {volume} L.
r_volume_plant_closed.remedy: Increase the volume or choose a more compact species.

r_volume_plant_open.msg: {species} needs at least {min_volume} L in an open or semi-open system; you have {volume} L.
r_volume_plant_open.remedy: Increase the volume or choose a compact species.

r_volume_fauna.msg: {species} needs at least {min_volume} L; you have {volume} L.
r_volume_fauna.remedy: Increase the volume or choose smaller fauna (springtails, dwarf isopods).

r_digging_small.msg: Burrowing species ({species}) in jars under 10 L destroy layers and collapse the ecosystem.
r_digging_small.remedy: Only 10 L and up, or choose surface-dwelling species.

r_plant_interest_large.msg: {species} actively eats live greens — in a small jar it will eat everything.
r_plant_interest_large.remedy: Only 10 L and up with dense planting, or species with no interest in greens.

r_plant_interest_small.msg: {species} may nibble tender shoots and moss in a cramped jar.
r_plant_interest_small.remedy: Watch the balance, feed regularly, or use springtails instead.

r_toxicity_plant_fauna.msg: {plant} is toxic if eaten, and {fauna} may eat it.
r_toxicity_plant_fauna.remedy: Keep fauna well fed (litter, food) or replace the plant or fauna.

r_fauna_secret.msg: {fauna} releases a toxic secretion when stressed — dangerous to neighbours.
r_fauna_secret.remedy: Do not overcrowd, provide hides; avoid combining with small fauna.

r_climate_mix.msg: Tropical and temperate species are mixed — they need different winter regimes.
r_climate_mix.remedy: Provide cool wintering or split species into separate builds.

r_dormancy.msg: {species} needs a cool winter rest, which a warm sealed jar cannot provide.
r_dormancy.remedy: Keep the jar at 10–15 °C in winter or choose a species without dormancy.

r_grow_light.msg: {species} needs bright light — without supplementation it will stretch and lose shape.
r_grow_light.remedy: Add a grow light (10–14 h/day) or move to a brighter spot.

r_growth_aggressive.msg: {species} will quickly fill a small jar and smother neighbours.
r_growth_aggressive.remedy: Trim every {interval} weeks or choose a slow-growing species.

r_multiple_aggressive.msg: There are {count} aggressive species in the build — they will compete.
r_multiple_aggressive.remedy: Keep one aggressive species; make the rest slow or medium growers.

r_feeding_closed.msg: {species} needs feeding — reaching into a sealed jar is awkward.
r_feeding_closed.remedy: Open the lid for feeding or choose self-sustaining fauna.

r_fauna_pest.msg: {species} is a pest: breeds fast and eats live plants.
r_fauna_pest.remedy: Do not add; if present, remove by hand and let the substrate dry slightly.

r_multiple_predators.msg: There are {count} predator species — they will compete and may eat each other.
r_multiple_predators.remedy: Keep a single predator (mites or nematodes).

r_global_intersection.msg: The build has no shared regime for "{field}" — the species are incompatible together.
r_global_intersection.remedy: Remove or replace one of the conflicting species ({a}, {b}).

r_light_optimum_mismatch.msg: Species have different light optima — the shared regime will be a compromise.
r_light_optimum_mismatch.remedy: Keep compromise indirect light or split species into separate builds.

r_no_cleanup_crew.msg: No cleanup crew in a closed or semi-open jar — mold risk.

r_closed_direct_sun.msg: A sealed jar in direct sun will overheat (+10–15 °C in an hour) and cook its contents.
r_closed_direct_sun.remedy: Move to a shaded spot or use indirect light.

r_semi_direct_sun.msg: A semi-open jar in direct sun may overheat.
r_semi_direct_sun.remedy: Shade with sheer fabric or move a metre back from the window.

r_water_distilled_required.msg: {species} requires distilled or RO water only — hard water is lethal.
r_water_distilled_required.remedy: Water with distilled, RO or rain water.

r_water_soft_recommended.msg: {species} is sensitive to hard water — expect limescale and brown leaf tips.

r_ph_conflict.msg: Stones or substrate push pH alkaline while {species} needs an acid range — the corridor is empty.
r_ph_conflict.remedy: Replace carbonate stones with quartz, granite or slate, or remove the acid-loving species.

r_ph_narrow.msg: The build's pH corridor is narrow (a single zone) — little margin.
r_ph_narrow.remedy: Avoid carbonate stones and use soft water.

r_ph_test_required.msg: {stone} may raise pH — a vinegar test is needed.
r_ph_test_required.remedy: Drop vinegar on it: fizzing means keep it away from acid-lovers; soak 3–5 days.

r_calcium_vs_acid.msg: Calcium (cuttlebone) will raise the pH of acid substrate — dangerous for acid-lovers.
r_calcium_vs_acid.remedy: Place cuttlebone locally on a feeding station, not in the substrate.

r_digging_style.msg: Burrowing fauna ({species}) will ruin clean layers and the style's geometry.
r_digging_style.remedy: Choose surface fauna or a style without strict geometry.

r_experience.msg: {species} is for experienced keepers: it needs stable conditions.
r_experience.remedy: For a first jar pick an easier species (fittonia, selaginella, moss).

r_narrow_neck.msg: Narrow neck: planting and maintenance only with tweezers.
r_narrow_neck.remedy: Use long tweezers; a closed system needs less intervention.

r_vessel_closure.msg: This vessel cannot be sealed ({shape}) — a closed system is impossible.
r_vessel_closure.remedy: Choose a vessel with a sealable lid or change the system type.

r_height_overflow.msg: {species} ({height} cm) is taller than the free space ({free_height} cm) — trimming will be needed.
r_height_overflow.remedy: Trim regularly or choose a shorter species.

r_height_no_fit.msg: {species} ({height} cm) will not fit even with trimming ({free_height} cm free).
r_height_no_fit.remedy: Choose a shorter species or a taller vessel.

r_overcrowding.msg: Planting exceeds the norm ({bucket}) — plants will be cramped.
r_overcrowding.remedy: Remove one plant or choose a more compact one.

r_overcrowding_hard.msg: Severe overcrowding ({bucket}): plants will run out of space.
r_overcrowding_hard.remedy: Remove 1–2 plants or increase the vessel size.

r_shallow.msg: Less than 8 cm above the substrate — only micro species and carpets.
r_shallow.remedy: Choose a taller vessel or only carpet and micro plants.

r_open_fauna_cover.msg: Open jar with fauna: snails escape and moisture leaves faster.
r_open_fauna_cover.remedy: Cover with mesh or use a semi-open system.

r_paludarium_min.msg: Water plus land needs a floor of at least 300 cm² — yours is smaller.
r_paludarium_min.remedy: Choose a wider vessel, e.g. 30×20 cm.

r_epiphyte_mount.msg: {species} is an epiphyte: it needs a mount (wood or stone), not substrate.
r_epiphyte_mount.remedy: Add driftwood or cork bark for attachment.

r_litter_feeding.msg: Leaf litter in the decor is already food for the cleanup crew.

r_monocarpic.msg: {species} blooms once: the rosette dies after flowering.
r_monocarpic.remedy: Keep the offsets — they will carry on the plant.

r_day_night_drop.msg: {species} needs a day/night temperature drop, otherwise pitchers will not form.
r_day_night_drop.remedy: Provide a 5–8 °C night drop or choose another species.

r_stone_sharp_fauna.msg: Sharp chips of {stone} can injure fauna.
r_stone_sharp_fauna.remedy: File the sharp edges smooth before placing.

air_humidity.remedy: Replace one of the species or change the system type.

soil_humidity.remedy: Succulents and bog species do not mix; pick one regime.

light.remedy: Pick species for one spot or add a grow light.

temperature.remedy: Split species with different wintering or heat needs into separate builds.
